correctness.rationale: At standard orthonormal coordinates each source-edge triple consists of three norm-squared 3 points, pairwise dot −1; disjoint edges give dot 0, incident distinct triples give dot ±1 according to their unique common endpoint. Hence diametral pairs are precisely within each triple and opposite endpoint-sign pairs across incident triples, giving diameter sqrt8 and 3m+4sum_v binom(deg(v),2) edges. A four-clique would have four vectors of norm²3 and pairwise dot −1, so sum zero, contradicting aggregate coordinate sum 4. Each triple is K3, and its unique negative endpoint-sign point carries a consistent source-vertex color forced across incident triples; opposite endpoints differ. The inverse colors each triple from the two source endpoint colors. Polynomial construction and connected graph 3-color NP-hardness complete the claim. Independent exact K2/P3/K3/C4 enumeration reproduced diameter edges 3/10/21/28 and P_D(3)=P_G(3)=6/12/6/18.
